projectTitle: 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展

prompts.coverprompt:
Use case: ads-marketing; edit/recompose the supplied Eleanor portrait into a polished square Steam Workshop cover, 1024x1024.
Input 1 is the precise Eleanor identity and anime pixel-art style reference. Input 2 is her scavenger outfit reference. Input 3 is the actual original pawnshop environment, for grounded sci-fi setting and muted plum/gray industrial palette only.
Keep Eleanor unmistakably the same ADULT young woman: long copper-orange wavy hair, side-swept fringe, emerald green eyes, gentle confident slightly teasing smile, dark plum sleeveless top with gold angular neckline trim and dark shoulder shawl. Her face, eye shape, hair color and costume should closely match input1. No new hair ornaments. 
Composition: one Eleanor only, chest-up at a worn lower-district pawnshop metal counter, looking warmly toward the viewer who is the unseen shopkeeper. Her face large in upper center-right; visible clean pixel clusters, fine dark outlines, controlled cel shading, anime-pixel illustration consistent with the reference, NOT photorealism, NOT smooth glossy mobile-game painting. Background modest shelves of used objects, an old compact terminal, muted metal panels and overhead industrial warm light, not a fantasy castle, not a cyberpunk skyline. Small closed oval gold locket on counter, secondary, not heart-shaped. Do not depict a male protagonist, mother, romance couple pose, weapons, extra people or added gameplay.
Cover typography is essential: warm ivory Chinese characters with subtle dark outline, carefully typeset in clear block/serif hybrid, generous spacing and no garbled glyphs. Keep these EXACT Chinese words, arranged into readable lines in bottom third on dark plum panel:
"上层区的富家千金"
"爱上在下层区开当铺的我"
"埃莉诺剧情扩展"
First two lines together form the full main title; third line is emphasized as the series subtitle. No other text, no English, no logos, no watermark, no promotional claims. Keep face and eyes fully unobstructed. Crisp legibility at thumbnail scale. Intimate, proud, warm, understated romantic mood with rich-girl/lower-district-pawnshop contrast. Square edge-to-edge opaque cover.
prompts.motherprompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Transform the supplied anime pixel-art NPC reference into a NEW character portrait: Eleanor's mother, a mature woman aged 48-55, former hydroponic farm manager, now rebuilding life in the lower district. This is not Eleanor herself. Reference1 defines the daughter and family resemblance only: warm copper-auburn hair, green eyes; reference2 defines same game's elegant anime pixel rendering and bust framing. 
Deliver one isolated transparent PNG game portrait, canvas aspect ratio 288:212 (1152x848 preferred, intended export 288x212). Same scale as supplied game portraits: head starts at 30 percent canvas height, face near center x, bottom torso meets bottom edge; figure occupies about central 50 percent of canvas width. Leave remaining area fully TRANSPARENT. Do NOT reproduce the horizontal colored background bands from the references.
Mature face with visible subtle smile lines and fine eye wrinkles, composed kind but firm gaze, slightly tired from imprisonment yet healthy enough for shopping; recognizable family resemblance without making her a clone of the young daughter. Auburn hair with a few gray streaks swept into a practical low bun, one loose curl, no long glamorous hair. Modest muted gray-green work blouse, ivory collar, worn charcoal-plum cardigan with subtle repaired seam. No lab-coat costume, no prison uniform, no huge jewelry, no hats, no weapons or props, no sexualized clothing. Upright front three-quarter torso, arms naturally below counter framing and no dramatic gesture. Clear silhouette.
Match anime PIXEL ART exactly: crisp limited-color pixel clusters, clean dark outlines, controlled small cel-shading patches, flat game sprite lighting. Not realistic, not smooth airbrushed splash painting, not chibi, no grain filter, no environment or text. Preserve actual alpha. Single character only.
prompts.lydiaprompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Transform the supplied reference portrait style into a NEW character portrait of Lydia, the adult upper-district former friend of Eleanor, approximately 27-32. She is a well-dressed, socially confident woman, initially class-conscious and sharp-tongued, capable of sincere self-reflection. NOT an evil villain or a jealous caricature.
References: Eleanor1 and the upper-district woman define the exact anime-pixel-art family, proportions and game presentation. Do not copy either woman's face or costume. Lydia has a short carefully arranged dark brown/plum bob, one side tucked behind the ear, muted hazel eyes, small gold earrings, a restrained expression with slightly raised brow and closed-mouth subtle smile. Modest refined deep dusty teal high-collared tailored jacket with one angular gold clasp; understated upper-district elegance, no crown, no tiara, no fantasy armor, no cleavage, no military insignia, no props, no weapon.
One transparent game portrait on a horizontal canvas with ratio 288:212, preferably 1152x848. Match original sprite placement: top of head at about 30 percent canvas height, centered face, central silhouette about 48-52 percent total width, bust runs to bottom edge without a floating lower cutout. Slight three-quarter pose, relaxed shoulders, arms out of frame. No background, no background stripes from the references, no border or text, actual alpha transparency.
Medium/style: crisp anime PIXEL ART, small deliberate color clusters, dark plum outlines, few cel-shading bands, warm skin, controlled muted colors. No glossy rendered skin, no painterly brushwork, no chibi. Keep the same game-art density as the supplied Eleanor image and clear readability when exported to 288x212. One consistent neutral speaking expression, not a sprite sheet.
prompts.locketprompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production game inventory item sprite: Eleanor's mother's closed gold oval locket on a short loop of chain. Reference1 is an actual item atlas from Probably Stolen: use ONLY its pixel scale, dark outlines, subdued antique colors and simple readable sprite shading; do not copy its entire sheet or its papers. Reference2 is an original 32x48 perfume item and defines tiny inventory asset density. 
Square transparent image, design on a strict effective 64x64 pixel grid (you may render integer enlarged pixels, but design MUST be readable at 64x64). Entire object inside canvas, 5px clear margin at effective size, one closed oval locket centered in lower-middle with a simple chain arch above. Closed engraved oval face with a tiny subtle two-leaf motif, a small hinge at edge and small bail connecting to chain, not a heart, no photograph, no gemstone, no religious symbol or writing. Muted old gold, ochre, brown shadow, small ivory glint, total restrained palette about 12-16 colors. Clearly outlined deliberately chunky pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, 1px dark-brown contour at effective size. Flat inventory view with a slight three-quarter tilt to reveal thickness, not isometric 3D render. The chain should be thick enough to survive tiny display (2px effective strokes), continuous simple curve without fussy individual links. Neutral light upper left. No cast shadow outside object, no background, no panel, no checkerboard baked in, no lettering, no other objects. Genuine alpha transparency. Must look like an in-game small valuable item, NOT a realistic jewelry advertisement or high-resolution illustration.

prompts.braceletprompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the placeholder gold bracelet in input1 into a finished small pixel-art inventory sprite. Input2 is the original Probably Stolen item atlas and defines tiny item rendering. Main fix: THE GOLD BAND AND THE GEMSTONE MUST BE PHYSICALLY CONNECTED. One continuous closed oval gold bangle seen in three-quarter top view, a small pale amber/ivory faceted stone securely inset in a raised gold bezel attached to the FRONT rim. Gold bezel touches and overlaps the rim with no floating gap. The whole bracelet is a single connected object. Opposite side has a tiny visibly replaced clasp in slightly duller brass. A few discrete old scratch pixels on the band, still elegant handcrafted upper-district jewelry.
Strict effective64x64 pixel design; all object within8px margin at final size. Wider than tall, centered in the square canvas, no clipped bottom. Transparent RGBA background. Match original game's limited antique gold/ochre/brown/ivory palette, about12-16 colors, dark outline, simple hard pixel clusters. Metal shading only2-3 clear bands, single light source upper left. Do not add detached jewels, extra chain, letters, sparkles, cast shadows or display stand. No gradient gloss, no photorealism, no background or baked checkerboard. Deliver single isolated bracelet, not a sheet.
